prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Minecraft vanilla-style 16x16 terrain texture atlas. Reference image is the project's existing soil top atlas, first 10 squares in reading order are the 10 ecosystems. Generate one opaque tightly packed atlas EXACTLY 5 columns x 4 rows, equal square tiles, no gaps, no borders, no labels. Each square must use a strict chunky 16x16 logical pixel grid, hard edges, restrained 6-10 colors, hand placed clusters like modern Minecraft dirt, mud, tuff and deepslate, NOT photo noise or smooth lighting. Row 1: five seamless subsoil textures for ecosystems 0-4. Row 2: subsoil textures for ecosystems 5-9. Row 3: five matching grass/moss soil SIDE textures for ecosystems 0-4. Row 4: side textures for ecosystems 5-9. The lower 12 pixels of each side tile MUST match its corresponding plain subsoil; only upper 4 pixels carry an irregular fringe of the corresponding plant colors from the reference. NO grass on plain subsoil. Ecosystems order 0 earthy olive gray fine loam with olive moss fringe, 1 pale muted blue gray chalk loam with mint-white fringe, 2 medium charcoal blue gray basalt loam with dark teal needle fringe and very rare copper root, 3 warm muted gray ochre limestone loam with golden moss fringe, 4 muted red brown loam with crimson foliage fringe, 5 gray teal silty loam with teal/olive fringe, 6 cool blue slate loam with blue gray fringe, 7 dusty muted rose brown gravel loam with coral fringe, 8 muted blue lilac loam with lavender moss fringe, 9 warm ochre gray loam with muted olive fringe. Do not add wood, tools, landscapes, objects or shadows.
